notes.title: Huge Log Away Demo Update!
notes.notes: [p]The Log Away demo has been just updated![/p][p]Based on the feedback we've been receiving since its release, we've unlocked new items and tools, and improved, overhauled, and fixed many things. The result is a better, smoother, and longer experience of the demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented a new, smoother camera system[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the in-game user interface[/p][/*][*][p]Improved various textures, lightning, sounds, 3D models[/p][/*][*][p]Added "The Eye" icon that hides/unhides the entire user interface[/p][/*][*][p]When hiding walls now everything hides except the door(s)[/p][/*][*][p]Added roofs as objects in the user interface (they were automatically added before)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new type of wall: squared logs with no bark[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked fences[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked many items and one additional interest (Fiber Arts)[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked two additional soundtrack genres (available now are: Western, Country, Blues)[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to delete saved Retreats (saved games)[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled DLSS[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Full Game Release[/h3][p]We continue to work hard towards the release of the full game. Many things will be improved, and some new added! Stay tuned for the release date announcement and updates. Adding the game to your wish list reminds you of the release and makes us serene and relaxed. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468400/Log_Away/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: First Demo Update Out Now
notes.notes: [p]We've just pushed the first update to the demo version of Log Away. It includes several tweaks, bug fixes, and general improvements for:[/p][list][*][p]Lightning,[/p][/*][*][p]Various items,[/p][/*][*][p]Textures,[/p][/*][*][p]Roofs,[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented dynamic chimney height relative to the height of the roof,[/p][/*][*][p]Ambient and SFX balancing and improvements, [/p][/*][*][p]Visual effects,[/p][/*][*][p]Day/Night progress is now unlocked by default.[/p][/*][/list][p]We've put a lot of effort into releasing this update today so you can enjoy the currently best version over the weekend. Go check it out and have fun![/p][p][/p]
